description: In scripts/harnesslib.py validate_provider_active: replace the hard raise at the sha mismatch (line ~303) with a fallback: if active['model_selections_sha256'] != selection_hash, accept when active.get('selections') == selection_payload.get('selections') (semantic identity; the runtime rewrote the file payload-identically); otherwise raise the integrity error. Add comment explaining the decision. Add the regression test at backend/tests/test_binding_drift.py (NOT tests/ at repo root): the deterministic check-runner derives the project root and its per-project unittest timeout from task files, and a task whose files include a repo-root tests/ path resolves project root to the repository root, whose full suite (~9-10 min) exceeds the runner's hardcoded 60s per-command cap (no override knob exists) - placing the regression test under the backend project makes the gate deterministic and fast (~2s). The test imports harnesslib via sys.path insert of the repo-root scripts directory. Two regression tests: (1) payload-identical re-serialization validates; (2) a selections payload change still raises. All existing backend tests must pass.
acceptance_criteria: validate_provider_active accepts a binding whose model-selections file was re-serialized payload-identically (different bytes, same selections)
validate_provider_active still rejects payload-divergent model-selections files (different selections content)
backend/tests/test_binding_drift.py contains the two regression tests (plus T0 control and T3 characterization) and passes under both python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and pytest from backend/
Whole backend test suite passes unchanged (~fast; the root-level tests/ suite is out of scope for this task's gate)
No changes outside scripts/harnesslib.py and backend/tests/test_binding_drift.py
Comment documents why the fallback exists (runtime self-rewrite, semantic second line of defense) and the test docstring documents the placement rationale (check-runner project-root timeout model)

planning.title: Semantic fallback for provider binding model-selections validation
